items.translation: 从此流内容解码出的一个 String

items.source: the current contents of this stream as a byte array
items.translation: 当前流的内容作为字节数组

items.source: Note that if any methods are called on this FastByteArrayOutputStream (including, but not limited to, any of the write methods, reset(), toByteArray(), and toByteArrayUnsafe()) then the InputStream's behavior is undefined.
items.translation: 注意，如果在此 `FastByteArrayOutputStream` 上调用任何方法（包括但不限于任何写入方法、reset()、toByteArray() 和 toByteArrayUnsafe()），则 `InputStream` 的行为未定义。

items.source: Unlike ByteArrayOutputStream, this implementation is backed by a ArrayDeque of byte[] buffers instead of one constantly resizing byte[]. It does not copy buffers when it gets expanded.
items.translation: 与ByteArrayOutputStream不同，此实现由一个byte[]缓冲区的ArrayDeque支持，而不是一个不断调整大小的byte[]。它在扩展时不会复制缓冲区。

items.source: The initial buffer is only created when the stream is first written. There is also no copying of the internal buffers if the stream's content is extracted via the writeTo(OutputStream) method.
items.translation: 初始缓冲区仅在首次写入流时创建。此外，如果通过writeTo(OutputStream)方法提取流的内容，内部缓冲区也不会被复制。

items.source: This method always replaces malformed-input and unmappable-character sequences with the default replacement string for the platform's default character set. The CharsetDecoder class should be used when more control over the decoding process is required.
items.translation: 此方法始终将格式错误的输入和无法映射的字符序列替换为平台默认字符集的默认替换字符串。当需要对解码过程进行更精细的控制时，应使用 CharsetDecoder 类。

items.source:
Also replaces the internal structures with the byte array to
conserve memory: if the byte array is being created anyway, we might
as well as use it. This approach also means that if this method is
called twice without any writes in the interim, the second call is
a no-op.
items.translation: 同时也用字节数组替换内部结构以节省内存：既然无论如何都要创建该字节数组，不如直接使用它。这种方法还意味着，如果在此方法被调用两次之间没有任何写入操作，则第二次调用将是一个空操作（no-op）。

items.source:
This method is "unsafe" as it returns the internal buffer.
Callers should not modify the returned buffer.
items.translation: 此方法“不安全”，因为它返回内部缓冲区。调用者不应修改返回的缓冲区。

items.source:
Its size is the current size of this output stream, and it will
contain the valid contents of the internal buffers.
items.translation: 其大小为此输出流的当前大小，并将包含内部缓冲区的有效内容。

items.source:
All currently accumulated output in the output stream is discarded.
The output stream can be used again.
items.translation:
当前输出流中所有已累积的输出均被丢弃。
输出流可再次使用。
